subject: Q2: Executive hiring approvals & offer guidance
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: ashley@ashaventures.com
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2: Executive hiring approvals & offer guidance

Team —

Attached is the Q2 hiring plan (v3) with the exec-level requests highlighted on tab 'Leadership'. Two items need explicit sign-off this week so we can move forward with offers and avoid losing candidates:

1) Headcount refresh: 2 additional Director-level ICs (Infra & Runtime) to be added to the Q2 commit.
2) Offer philosophy: approve a target cash + equity envelope for Director and Senior Director bands for external hires sourced this quarter.

Background: recruiting has an excellent candidate (Molly Chen) for Director, Runtime. Asha (cc'd) thinks the market requires us to be within the top 25% of cash + eq package or expect a counter. We already have the draft offer attached (Offer_Approval_Form_MollyChen.pdf).

Requested actions:
- Laura: confirm headcount availability against FY plan and sign off on adding 2 Director FTEs to Q2.
- Evelyn: confirm comp band alignment and whether comp committee sign-off is required for this envelope.
- Dev / Aditya: any operational constraints (budget, ramp timing, recruiting timeline)?

I propose we do a quick 30m sync Monday if there are lingering questions, otherwise please reply-all with approvals so I can route to HR for formal offer.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Product & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_Hiring_Plan_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Comp_Band_Guidelines_v2.pdf (policy), Offer_Approval_Form_MollyChen.pdf (offer stub)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, ashley@ashaventures.com
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2: Executive hiring approvals & offer guidance

Markus —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. I reviewed the Q2 workbook. Quick answers:

- Headcount: We have a 2-headroom buffer in the Q2 approved plan; I can authorize adding the 2 Director FTEs, but we need to mark them as "conditional" on offer acceptance and a hiring freeze clause if macro changes appear.
- Budget: Funding is available in hiring pool #2 (Product & Infrastructure). Please tag requisitions with code P-INF-2026-Q2 so finance can track.

One ask: can we ensure the equity allocation stays within the published band? If we push above that for competitiveness, we should pre-clear with Compensation. Evelyn, can you advise?

Approve adding the 2 Director roles to Q2 contingent on the above.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief People Officer
Redwood Inference

Laura / Markus —

Thanks for the heads-up. A few notes from Comp & Rewards:

- The Comp_Band_Guidelines_v2.pdf is the most recent. Directors: market midpoint is $210k base + target equity 0.25% (range 0.15%–0.4%). Senior Director midpoint is $320k base + target equity 0.6%.
- For market-competitive offers, we can stretch up to +10% cash and +25% equity from midpoint with executive pre-approval. Anything beyond that requires the comp committee sign-off and documentation.
- For Molly Chen specifically: Asha's benchmark suggests she expects $230k base and 0.35% eq. That is within the stretch band — we can approve at the exec level without comp committee if the hiring manager documents the reason (rare skills in runtime ops) and LAURA signs-off.

Next steps:
- Laura: formal sign-off on the stretch approval for this candidate (Molly). If you approve, I'll mark the offer as "approved — comp stretch" and HR can extend.
- Dev: confirm that the hire timeline (start date target 2026-06-15) fits the team ramp plan.

Evelyn Hart
SVP, People Operations (Compensation)

Markus / Team —

Operational constraints: hiring two Director-level roles is fine for Q2. A couple of considerations:

- Onboarding seats: infra team can onboard one Director by 6/15; second will likely be 7/1 depending on training schedule. That aligns with platform roadmap, but we should be explicit in offer language about start-date flexibility.
- Budget coding: finance will need requisitions submitted with P-INF-2026-Q2 by May 10 so headcount shows up in payroll forecasting.

No blockers from my side. Good to proceed once Laura signs the comp stretch for Molly.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
